headline: Stryker declares an $0.88 per share quarterly dividend
summary: Portage, Michigan, Aug. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Stryker (NYSE:SYK) announced that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly dividend of $0.88 per share payable October 30, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on September 30, 2026, representing an increase of 4.8% versus the prior year and unchanged from the previous quarter.
